{"text":"ItemID: 1; Title: Adhesive Guru CA Glue with Activator Woodworking (3.5 oz - 13,5 fl oz) Ca Glue for Woodworking, Cyanoacrylate Glue and Activator (1 Pack); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Quick bonding would complement the epoxy and adhesive tapes I have bought for DIY repairs.
ItemID: 2; Title: PLA 3D Printer Filament Bundle, TINMORRY PLA Filament 1.75mm, 250g x 5 Spools, Black+White+Blue+Red+Green, Net Weight 1.25kg; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current printing project or established need for printer filament.
ItemID: 3; Title: M8-1.25 x 20mm (12 pcs) Button Socket Head Cap Screws, Hexagon Head, Allen Hex Drive, 304 Stainless Steel 18/8, ISO 7380; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These extend the sizes in my recent metric fastener assortment and could be useful for mechanical assembly.
ItemID: 4; Title: Luftzeuge Black PLA Filament 1.75mm with Good Adhesion - Fit Most FDM Printers - Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03 mm for High Precision - 1 KG Spool; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A full spool is not useful to me without a specific 3D printing need.
ItemID: 5; Title: Duct Tape Heavy Duty Waterproof Bulk of 5, 11 Mils Black Duct Tape 2 inches x 33 Yards, Max Strength No Residue Industrial Tape, Tear by Hand for DIY Repairs, Industrial, All-Weather Multipurpose Use; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Heavy-duty repair tape fits my repeated interest in adhesives and practical workshop supplies.
ItemID: 6; Title: 100 Nitrile Exam Gloves 3.5 Mil - Latex & Powder Free, Disposable Non-Sterile Protective Gloves By PlastCare; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Disposable gloves could be useful, but I would check chemical compatibility and durability before choosing these for resin work.
ItemID: 7; Title: 3D Printer Filament Bundle Multicolor, JAYO PLA Filament 1.75mm, Neatly Wound Filament 2.5kg, 250g Spool, 10 Pack, Black+White+Grey+Blue+Red+Green+Yellow+Orange+Transparent+Burly Wood; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A large multicolor filament bundle does not address my current repair and fastening needs.
ItemID: 8; Title: TKDMR 190 PCS Heat Shrink Tubing Kit - 1.75" Length 4:1 Ratio Adhesive Lined, Marine Grade Shrink Wrap - Industrial Heat-Shrink Tubing - Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: An assortment for insulating and protecting wire repairs would be a useful addition to my DIY supplies.
ItemID: 9; Title: KEYXE 8Pcs Screw Eyes, 3.2 Inch Black Eye Hooks Screw Self Tapping Eye, Heavy Duty Eye Bolt for Wood Securing Cables Wire, Hammock Stand, Indoor & Outdoor Use; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Mounting hardware interests me, but I would wait until I need hooks this large for a specific job.
ItemID: 10; Title: DiCUNO 100pcs Pre-Wired SMD 0805 Light Emitting Diodes, Pre-soldered Micro LED for DIY, Science Projects, Wire Length 16cm (6.3"), Red/Yellow/Green/Blue/White (5 Colors x 20pcs); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am focused on repair tools and fastening supplies, with no current project needing miniature LEDs."}
